title: Rule 7 multicast scope oracle omits reserved scope 0 and valid upper boundary 14
description: The new Rule 7 policy normatively accepts multicast destination scopes 2..14 and rejects 0,1,15, but schc_adaptation address-policy vectors cover scope2 valid, scope1 invalid, and scope15 invalid only. Add ff00:: invalid and ff0e:: valid boundary cases so consumers cannot implement the predicate as scope!=1&&scope!=15 or otherwise miss the lower/upper inclusivity.
